claim: From 4th through 12th grade, the share of students reporting favorable school belonging is 72.8%, 67.8%, 46.4%, 38.2%, 35.2%, 33.4%, 32.4%, 33.8% and 36.4%.

source: Sixth-graders feel way less school belonging
claim: The share of students reporting favorable school belonging is 67.8% in 5th grade but 46.4% in 6th grade.

source: Oh. Things don’t get better for seventh graders.
claim: The share of students reporting favorable school belonging falls from 46.4% in 6th grade to 38.2% in 7th grade.

source: Sorry to break it to you. But your sense of belonging stays low through eighth grade and then high school.
claim: The share of students reporting favorable school belonging is 35.2% in 8th grade and 33.4%, 32.4%, 33.8% and 36.4% in 9th through 12th grade, down from 67.8% in 5th grade.

source: I mean, it actually does improve a bit, especially later in high school.
claim: The share of students reporting favorable school belonging rises from 32.4% in 10th grade to 33.8% in 11th grade and 36.4% in 12th grade.

source: It only gets a little better, though.
claim: By 12th grade, the share of students reporting favorable school belonging is 36.4%, still far below the 67.8% in 5th grade.
